name: Almeria Eisenhut
original_name: アルメリア・アイゼンフート
source:
A kindly sister who belongs to the Imperial Church.
There isn't a single citizen who doesn't adore her.
She also serves as the Archpriest, and she's known Emperor Gwyn since his princely period.
Apparently, they're pretty close.

[From Digital Artwork book]
